verdict.rationale: Inngest publishes a documented REST API (api-docs.inngest.com) covering events, function runs, and environments, confirmed live and auth-gated in runtime probes (HTTP 401 with proper error format), plus a CLI and MCP server for programmatic/agent-driven interaction. This directly satisfies driving the product via a documented public API. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found all candidate OpenAPI paths 404'd), which would make the API more machine-consumable for AI-native tooling.
